name: Aoki Chiharu
source:
An international student from America who commutes from Habataki City to Kirameki High School. Although he has a polite and gentle personality, he also has a side that easily becomes sensitive and homesick due to living alone in an unfamiliar foreign country. He frequently exchanges emails with his family, which leads to an unexpected encounter with the protagonist... He loves Japan and works hard every day to actively learn about Japanese culture. His dream is to make use of that in the future and become a diplomat.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
